candidates.title: VestingDeployer.setTokenOwner keys the check on the OWNER slot, not the TOKEN -> multiple owners can claim the same token -> unauthorized createVesting/transferVesting
candidates.description: `require(_tokenOwner[_owner] == address(0)); _tokenOwner[_owner] = token;` only ensures a given OWNER hasn't been assigned a token — it never checks the TOKEN already has an owner. Admin (or repeated calls) can map several owner addresses to the same token; deployVesting/createVesting/transferVesting authorize via `_tokenOwner[msg.sender] == token`, so any of those owners can create/transfer vestings for that token (arbitrary vesting mint/transfer). Fix: key uniqueness on the token (`tokenToOwner[token] == 0`).

candidates.title: spotPurchase performs all token transfers BEFORE decrementing listing.balance (CEI violation) -> reentrancy via hook/callback currency drains a listing
candidates.description: spotPurchase has no nonReentrant guard; _handleTransfers does safeTransferFrom(buyer) + safeTransfer(seller) + safeTransfer(feeCollector) and only AFTER does `listing.balance -= _amount`. A currency token with a transfer hook (ERC777/callback, admin-whitelisted via addCoin which no longer validates the token) lets the buyer re-enter spotPurchase before balance is decremented, buying the same balance repeatedly. Fix: nonReentrant + CEI (decrement balance before transfers).

candidates.title: Referral reward is computed and emitted but never PAID to the referrer (feeCollector keeps the full buyer fee)
candidates.description: _handleTransfers computes referralFeeCost and spotPurchase emits it in Purchased, but no transfer to `_referral` ever happens — buyerFeeTotal+sellerFeeTotal are sent entirely to feeCollector. The referral program is a no-op on-chain (referrers earn nothing) / the discount the buyer should get is not applied. Fix: actually transfer the referral reward (or reduce the buyer charge).

candidates.title: listVesting does not bound discountPct <= BASE -> _getDiscountedPrice underflow reverts (FIX/LINEAR) -> listing un-buyable (DoS) or mispriced
candidates.description: listVesting only checks discountType!=NO => discountPct>0; it never bounds discountPct <= BASE(10000). _getDiscountedPrice FIX computes `pricePerUnit*(BASE - discountPct)/BASE` (underflow revert if >BASE) and LINEAR `BASE - (_amount*discountPct/total)` (can underflow) -> any purchase reverts, DoSing the listing; near-BASE discount drives price ~0. Fix: require discountPct <= BASE.

candidates.title: StepVesting transfer into an EXISTING vesting ignores the incoming stepsClaimed -> vesting schedule drift (faster/slower release)
candidates.description: When a beneficiary who already has a vesting receives a transfer (buy), _createVesting else-branch does totalAmount += amount and recomputes releaseRate using the EXISTING beneficiary stepsClaimed, discarding the grantor's stepsClaimed passed in. The merged tokens then vest on the recipient's schedule, not their own -> a buyer with many stepsClaimed releases newly-bought tokens over fewer remaining steps (faster), or vice-versa. Accounting/value drift across transfers. Fix: track per-tranche schedules or normalize stepsClaimed on merge.

candidates.title: addCoin decimals validation is commented out -> unsafe/fee-on-transfer/odd-decimals currency can be whitelisted, breaking transfer accounting
candidates.description: The decimals()/try-catch validation in addCoin is commented out, so any token can be added as currency. _handleTransfers safeTransferFrom(buyer, baseAmount+buyerFeeTotal) then transfers baseAmount-sellerFeeTotal to seller + fees to collector; a fee-on-transfer currency makes the contract receive less than it pays out -> later transfers revert / contract shortfall. Fix: restore decimals + behavior validation, or block fee-on-transfer.

candidates.title: claimable() underflows when stepsClaimed > currentStep (transferred vesting before its steps elapse)
candidates.description: claimableSteps = currentStep - vesting.stepsClaimed. A vesting created via transfer inherits the grantor's stepsClaimed; if currentStep (from elapsed time) < that stepsClaimed, the subtraction underflows/reverts, bricking claim() for that beneficiary. Edge but reachable. Fix: clamp to zero.
